pgss_functions.sql:
select left(query, 140) as query_head,
           calls,
           round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 1) as mean_ms,
           round(total_exec_time::numeric, 0) as total_ms,
           rows,
           round((coalesce(wal_bytes, 0) / 1024.0 / 1024.0)::numeric, 2) as wal_mb
    from extensions.pg_stat_statements
    where query ilike '%refresh_style_guide_matviews%'
       or query ilike '%refresh_style_group_counts%'
       or query ilike '%clear_style_group_batch%'
       or query ilike '%rebuild_style_groups_batch%'
    order by calls desc
    limit 40

cron_jobs.sql: select jobid, schedule, jobname, active from cron.job where jobid in (9, 12) order by jobid

cron_runs_7d.sql:
select jobid,
           count(*) as runs,
           count(*) filter (where status = 'succeeded') as ok,
           count(*) filter (where status <> 'succeeded') as not_ok,
           round(avg(extract(epoch from (end_time - start_time)))::numeric, 2) as avg_s,
           round(max(extract(epoch from (end_time - start_time)))::numeric, 2) as max_s
    from cron.job_run_details
    where jobid in (9, 12) and start_time > now() - interval '7 days'
    group by jobid
    order by jobid
